lines.en: My treads grind over gravel with a crunch.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，怕震松螺丝。
lines.en: I move slowly so my screws stay tight.

lines.zh: 每走一步，指示灯闪一下。
lines.en: Each step makes my indicator light blink.
I drag my power cable behind me.
My strut legs slip in the mud.
I steer around a fallen comrade.
The gears mesh with a single click.
I carry a medicine case, so I cannot hurry.
A blade of grass jams my wheel; one moment.
I travel in straight lines, never detours.
The shaking loosens my cover plate.
I creep closer to the injured.
Standing by; all systems normal.
I scan the injuries around me.
Enough serum remains for three doses.
My fan spins to vent the heat.
No wounded, so I idle.
I run a self-check on my joints.
My range is small; I never forget.
The redstone circuit warms slightly.

lines.zh: 我数着路过的灾厄村民。
lines.en: I count the illagers passing by.
Quiet, except for the hum of current.
You are not a villager; scanning you.
Players do not require treatment.
My lens focuses on your hands.
You carry a weapon; I raise alertness.
I move my light onto your face.
You stand outside my treatment radius.
I log your height and weight.
Do not block my lens.
I blink; it is actually a reboot.

lines.zh: 看你一眼，判断威胁等级。
lines.en: One glance to judge your threat level.
My shell is cracked, but I still run.
A part fell off; logging it.
The circuit shorts; sparks fly.
That blow jammed my gears.
I shake off the debris.
Damage at twelve percent.
I wobble and brace against the wall.
My repair routine engaged itself.
I cannot tell whether this hurts.
Not the case; the medicine is inside.

lines.zh: 面包塞不进我的燃料槽。
lines.en: Bread does not fit into my fuel slot.
I need redstone, not bread.

lines.zh: 你举着胡萝卜，我无反应。
lines.en: You hold a carrot; I do not react.

lines.zh: 电量不足才是我关心的。
lines.en: Low charge is what concerns me.

lines.zh: 食物会堵住我的进料口。
lines.en: Food would clog my intake port.
Bring the redstone closer; let me look.
I cannot smell, and cannot eat.
Feeding me would only dirty my chassis.
That iron ingot is more useful than bread.
I trade my loyalty for electricity.
Collision detected; my shell is dented.
You knocked my strut out of alignment.
Please maintain one meter of distance.
The impact spun me around.
Do not step on my power cable.
I shift my balance and stay upright.
The bump triggered my alarm.
My cover plate popped open.
Step aside; I am going to help someone.
One bump, one log entry.
I have no reproduction module.
The engineers never installed that.

lines.zh: 两个机器也造不出小机器。
lines.en: Two machines cannot produce a small machine.

lines.zh: 我的同类都是流水线造的。
lines.en: My kind are built on an assembly line.

lines.zh: 配对不在我的任务清单。
lines.en: Pairing is not on my task list.
I repair people; I do not bear them.

lines.zh: 别问我这个，我拒绝回答。
lines.en: Do not ask; I refuse to answer.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是那台充电桩。
lines.en: My partner is that charging post.

lines.zh: 我被造出来，不是被养出来。
lines.en: I was built, not raised.
That instruction does not exist.
I collect only parts and vials.
A screw on the ground; mine.
Bending sets off a warning tone.
This iron plate can patch my shell.
I pick up a dropped medicine pack.
Do not stuff trash into my case.
My mechanical arm grips firmly.
This redstone still holds a charge.
Collected items must be logged.

lines.zh: 我拿不了太多，容量有限。
lines.en: I cannot carry much; capacity is limited.

lines.zh: 威胁识别，优先保护伤员。
lines.en: Threat identified; protect the wounded first.
You leveled a weapon at us.
I mark you as a hostile unit.
Stay away from my patients.
The alarm sounds; I engage defense.
You are not a villager; you are interference.
I plant myself in front of the wounded.
Too close; preparing to repel.
I raise my mechanical arm.
For my comrades, I must stop you.
I see whoever you intend to kill.
Scan complete; you are strong.
Shield energy routed to the front.

lines.zh: 我会拖住你，直到他们撤走。
lines.en: I will hold you until they withdraw.
Healing halted; turning to you.
I aim my nozzle at you.
Coolant flows through my pipes.
Every move of yours gets calculated.
My fist is a repair hammer.
Do not assume a machine feels no pain.
I lower my struts, ready to charge.
You are three steps from the wounded.
Current gathers in my joints.
I count the gaps in your guard.
Lock complete; I may engage.
I push power to maximum.

lines.zh: 你每退半米，我轮子就前进。
lines.en: Every half meter you yield, my wheels advance.
This is your final warning.

lines.zh: 治疗模式关闭，防御模式开。
lines.en: Healing off; defense mode on.

lines.zh: 我把肩甲转向你，护住火芯。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder plate over the core.

lines.zh: 你举起斧头，我算好落点。
lines.en: Axe raised; landing point computed.
The wounded are behind me; no retreat.

lines.zh: 我的轮子碾过碎石，稳住。
lines.en: Wheels grind the rubble and hold.
My repair hammer slams your shoulder.
I jab you with the shock tip.
That strike used standard force.
My shell hits you like a wall.
I clamp onto your wrist.
A serum tube whips across your face.
My arm recoils slowly.
I shove you aside to reach my comrade.
Hit confirmed; logging the result.
Do not make me strike again.
My gears bite into your armor.
This blow is for the wounded.
My motion is clumsy, but heavy.
Do not block the healing path.
The hammer haft sweeps your knee.
Three steps back; that is enough.
Startup complete; systems online.
I come from the engineers' workshop.
My wheels land and hold steady.
Medicine case full; I am ready.
Where are the wounded here?
My indicator lights up green.
I unfold my struts and stand tall.
Screws are still loose; one moment.
I must arrive before my comrades fall.
I carry three vials of serum.
Welding marks from the workshop remain.
If you are hurt, report your position.
The heat softens my wiring.
The fall bent my struts.
Water in my circuits; everything shorts.

lines.zh: 冲击波掀掉我半块盖板。
lines.en: The blast tears off half my cover plate.
An arrow lodges in my vent.
Magic interferes with my calibration.
My charge is nearly gone; movements slow.
Lightning overloads me; I go numb.
No signal reaches anyone from the void.
